## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The refresh helper can erase evidence of edits to tracked files and should be corrected before merge. All changed files and tests were read; tests were not run.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — When `tracked.txt` has been edited and `names` contains `["tracked.txt", "new.txt"]`, refresh replaces its original fingerprint, causing `verify` to accept the edited file. Preserve existing fingerprints by delegating to `register_new_files` or applying its membership check. — Refreshing after adding files can silently erase detection of hand-edited tracked content.
